model: IN485MIT001A000 (Mitsubishi Electric Ecodan gateway, BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Mitsubishi Electric Ecodan air-to-water units, connected to the CN105 socket of the Ecodan controller board.
summary: Intesis interface for one Mitsubishi Electric Ecodan air-to-water system, plugged into CN105 and speaking BACnet MS/TP (default) or Modbus RTU. It exposes 115 objects: system and zone on/off, heat/cool mode, zone 1 and zone 2 setpoints with limits and water temperatures, DHW control (eco, boost, legionella), holiday mode, compressor, pump and backup-heater status, flow and energy counters.
notes: The manual's object table has no read/write column. Access is inferred: AO/BO/MO command objects as commandable, inputs as read-only.
Footnote numbers printed after some object names in the table (for example ErrorCode_status2) are not part of the name and were removed.
ErrorCode_status (AI 2) shows the code as a Mitsubishi centralized controller shows it; ErrorSubCode_status (AI 3) shows it as the Ecodan unit shows it.
Run-hour and flow counters roll back to 0 at 720896; energy counters at 2147483647 kWh.
Temperatures follow the °C/°F setting on DIP switch SW2 position 8.

source.title: IN485MIT001A000 User Manual - Mitsubishi Electric Ecodan Air-to-Water Units to BACnet MS/TP and Modbus RTU

integration.summary: Plug the gateway into CN105 on the Ecodan board, leave SW1 position 5 OFF for BACnet MS/TP and set the MAC address on SW2. Turn the system on with OnOff_command, set heat or cool with ZonesMode_command (both zones follow), and write zone and DHW setpoints to their _command objects.

minimum_points.name: ZonesMode_command
minimum_points.why: Heat or cool for both zones

integration.enable: BO 3 RemoteControlLock_command = 1 lets only the BMS control the unit; remote-controller commands are then ignored.
integration.remote_sensors: Write a BMS room temperature to AO 8 Zone1TempBACnetRoomThermAmbientRef_command (AO 22 for zone 2). Once a valid value is written, the gateway's Virtual Temperature function uses it to offset the setpoint.
setup: SW1 P5: OFF = BACnet MS/TP (default), ON = Modbus RTU; SW1 P6-P8 baud rate, autobaud by default.
MS/TP MAC address on SW2 P1-P7; SW2 P8 selects °C (default) or °F.
Default device instance 246000; in automatic mode it is 246000 + the MAC address. Writing Object_Identifier switches to manual addressing until a factory reset.
DIP switch changes take effect after a reboot.
gotchas: Write the _command object and read the matching _status object; they have different object types and instance numbers.
Custom setpoint limits cannot go past the unit's own limits (the Unit...Limit objects); the Applied...Limit objects show the range in force.
Write 0 to CompressorOperatingTime_command or CirculationPumpOperatingTime_command to reset that run-hour counter.
